proofs.text: Run `add` and then `sync` against a project directory, and verify the parent directory of that project still holds exactly the four entries it held before: the two bare repositories, the anchor checkout and the project

rule_text: Every file the module writes lies under the project root it was given

tests.body:
def test_nothing_written_outside_the_project_root(workspace):
    """Every path the module writes is under the project root it was given."""
    _add(workspace)
    _advance(workspace)
    upstream.sync(workspace.root, names=['no_eval'])
    parent = os.path.dirname(workspace.root)
    assert sorted(os.listdir(parent)) == [
        'policies.git', 'policies_work', 'project', 'project.git']
tests.name: test_nothing_written_outside_the_project_root
